steps.placeholder: I use… I still think about…

cards.title: Checking: quick review
cards.body: Use the inverse ($c + b = a$) or casting out nines: the digit-sum remainders must match. A failed check means the answer is wrong.

cards.title: Choosing a strategy: quick review
cards.body: Look first: a round number nearby, a pair that makes $10$ or $100$, a middle number, or a square ending in $5$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Speed & Accuracy outside school?
